decisions.reason: The online customer portal lies far from the firm's established paper-display knowledge, so despite its in-house R&D the firm cannot readily interpret or improve early results.
This packaging display builds on the firm's established offer and has already won a packaging award, showing the firm can assimilate and apply related knowledge.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the firm's existing cardboard display capabilities, allowing the firm to learn from and improve the product.
The small counter display is close to the firm's established offer and benefits from related design and production knowledge.
The large freestanding information display is close to the firm's existing cardboard display expertise, so the firm can interpret results and refine it.
